title: aibus workflow v1
description: A workflow file (.aibus/workflows/<name>.toml, or workflows/<name>.toml inside a .aibus bundle) read as JSON: a named chain of delegations. This schema covers the shape only. It cannot express the template rules (a {{...}} must close, be one of input, prev.summary or steps.<agent>.summary, have no prev.summary in the first step, and name an agent that comes earlier), and it cannot know which agents exist. `aibus workflow validate` checks both.

name.description: The workflow's name; the file name is used when this is left out.

agent.description: The agent that runs this step.

prompt.description: What the agent is asked. May use {{input}}, {{prev.summary}} and {{steps.<agent>.summary}}.

gate.description: A shell command run after the step with hook semantics; exit 2 stops the chain.

on_fail.description: When this step fails, the step before it and this one run again, at most N times.
